tasks.description: Create the root Maven reactor and shortener-service Spring Boot module, Java 21 bootstrap, pinned dependencies/plugins and checksum-pinned executable Maven wrapper. Include web, JDBC, H2, test starter; configure Surefire *Test and Failsafe *IT through verify with no test skipping. Ignore build outputs and development database files. Record selected versions and launch commands in task evidence; do not create business code/tests/docs.

Implement the exact shared domain records, exceptions, UrlValidator and injectable CodeGenerator/SecureRandomCodeGenerator contract in plan.md. Preserve accepted URLs unchanged; enforce all specified validation and code rules. No persistence, service or controller implementation.

Implement LinkRepository and JDBC adapter per plan contract, exact idempotent schema, parameterized SQL, fresh autocommit inserts, collision-specific mapping, atomic increment/read transaction, case-sensitive lookups and real connectivity checks. Never reset data.

Implement LinkService per shared contract: validate destinations/codes, ten collision attempts, duplicate destinations create separate links, GET increments once after commit, HEAD resolves without increment, stats/health do not mutate. Propagate unexpected failures rather than treating them as collisions.

Implement exact HTTP/JSON/error/header contracts, explicit HEAD route, strict object/trailing JSON handling, configured public origin, file H2 defaults and idempotent startup configuration. Match plan interfaces; no destination fetches, no caches or startup resets.

Author *Test unit tests against shared domain/service contracts using controlled collaborators. Cover validation boundaries/preservation, generation, retries/exhaustion, unknown codes, noncollision errors and nonmutating operations. No production or build edits; service may not yet exist until combined verification.

Author MockMvc *IT HTTP/error/header/HEAD/stats/health tests and real H2 collision/concurrency tests. Add separate file-H2 restart IT closing/reopening two contexts. Assert exact destinations, counts, case sensitivity, existing-row preservation and ten-collision exhaustion. Isolate databases, bound concurrency, contact no destinations. No production/build edits.

Document setup/JDK/pinned build, root ./mvnw verify and run commands, persistent DB paths and configuration, public origin, complete API/errors/examples and exact schema. Include HEAD/count semantics, concurrency/restarts and exclusions. Keep instructions consistent with actual build and application.

Run owner-configured maven-verify from root on combined deliverables. Record actual exit code and Surefire/Failsafe reports; confirm unit and integration tests ran, including restart and concurrency. Do not edit files or weaken gates.

Read-only final review of combined candidate and actual verification evidence against every acceptance criterion, file scopes, persistence safety, documentation and wrapper/build reproducibility. Record findings and candidate risk; only user may approve. Do not integrate or execute further tasks automatically.
